- **ANZ Group is deliberately NOT published.** Its FY2026 full-year results were released Monday 9 November at 10:00 AEDT = **23:00 ET on SUNDAY 8 November** ,
- so by the fleet's ET-day rule (a print belongs to the ET day its timestamp falls on) it belongs to the 8 November brief, not today's.
- **SoftBank Corp's US line is SOBKY (OTC ADR) - NOT SFTBY.** SFTBY / SFBQF are SoftBank **Group**, a different issuer, and SoftBank Corp (9434) is the telecom carrier.
- Mixing the two would publish the wrong company.
- **UniCredit has no issuer-sponsored US line** - the issuer lists only Milan, Frankfurt and Warsaw.
- The only US-accessible line is **UNCRY**, an UNSPONSORED OTC depositary receipt (1 ordinary share = 2 DRs), which is why `us_tradeable` reads `ADR (OTC)` and not `none`.
- **Barrick Mining** files 40-F/6-K with the SEC (no 10-K, no 10-Q) and is dual-listed NYSE: B / TSX: ABX.
- Its 40-F registers the NYSE common shares under Exchange Act 12(b) and the TSX line is a co-listing of the same shares - not an ADR - so Barrick is published in the US roster and not repeated in the non-US table.

- S&P 500 membership verified against the live constituent list (503 symbols, all three symbol templates parsed) - never from memory.
